description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationAPI class within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. The class provides REST API endpoints for managing employee termination records, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting termination data. It incorporates validation rules, API documentation annotations (OpenAPI/Swagger), and uses traits and models specific to the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationAPI
classes.description: A REST API class providing endpoints to handle employee termination records, including CRUD operations, validation, and integration with the HRM system's models and services.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee termination record based on employee number and record ID, returning a resource result with the termination data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee termination record for a specified employee, setting termination reasons, date, and notes.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee termination record with new data such as reason, date, and notes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an employee’s termination record, effectively removing the termination association from the employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules applicable when retrieving a specific termination record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a termination record, including required fields and constraints.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating a termination record, including ID validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting a termination record, primarily validating employee accessibility.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number and termination record ID from request parameters.

methods.name: setEmployeeTerminationRecord
methods.description: Populates an EmployeeTerminationRecord object with data from the request, including reason, date, and notes.
